name: monitoring
description: System monitoring and metrics collection tools for observability and performance analysis

tools.description: Command-line tooling for Prometheus monitoring system configuration and rule validation
tools.usage:
promtool check config prometheus.yml # Validate Prometheus config
promtool check rules rules.yml # Validate recording/alerting rules
promtool query instant 'up' # Execute instant query
promtool test rules test.yml # Test rules with sample data

tools.description: Agent for collecting and reporting metrics from systems, applications, and sensors
tools.usage:
telegraf --input-list # List available input plugins
telegraf --config telegraf.conf # Run with specific config
telegraf --test # Test configuration and output sample metrics
telegraf --config-directory /etc/telegraf/conf.d # Use config directory
